proposed_cascade_features.tail_n_legs_scheduled: Number of legs this tail is scheduled for today. More legs = more cascade opportunity.
proposed_cascade_features.tail_min_turn_time: Minimum scheduled turn time for this tail today. Tight turns have less recovery buffer.
proposed_cascade_features.tail_mean_turn_time: Average scheduled turn time. Loose schedules absorb delays better.
proposed_cascade_features.tail_has_tight_turn: Binary: any turn < 45 min in today's rotation. Single tight turn can cascade the rest of the day.
proposed_cascade_features.tail_first_dep_hour: First scheduled departure hour. Early starts accumulate more legs.
proposed_cascade_features.tail_route_complexity: Number of unique airports in today's rotation. More airports = more weather/congestion exposure.
proposed_cascade_features.tail_historical_delay_propensity: Tail's 14-day rolling delay rate. Some aircraft consistently delay (maintenance issues, configuration problems).
proposed_cascade_features.tail_schedule_buffer_ratio: Total scheduled block time / total actual block time (historical). Tight scheduling leaves less slack.
